Read [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and the [C++ standard](../../.agent/standards/cpp.md) for C++ code and headers used by C++. Use the [C++ engineering skill](../../.agent/skills/sb-cpp-engineering/SKILL.md) and the appropriate [feature](../../.agent/workflows/feature-development.md) or [defect](../../.agent/workflows/defect-investigation.md) workflow. For shared C/C++ headers and firmware, follow the standard's interoperability and target-context guidance.
